summary: Nine supported inline suggestions in two atomic groups fix fixed-size locale-format buffers and seconds-field selection for customized short-time formats. Final R5 was consumed at the five-request cap. Exact unchanged upstream, both independently selectable raw-literal groups and the combined candidate compiled. Unsupported DST-throw and common-control proposals are withdrawn; modern C# native-integer/struct expressions compile unchanged. No runtime locale/UI, full-suite or cloud-convergence claim.

status.label: Nine validated Awake inline suggestions

comments.title: Query and allocate required locale buffer

selection_group.title: Size locale format buffers from GetLocaleInfoEx

confidence.rationale: Microsoft documents cchData=0 as the required-size query; the fixed 80-character limit is unsupported for custom locale data.

comments.title: Read locale format into the allocated buffer

selection_group.title: Size locale format buffers from GetLocaleInfoEx

comments.body:
### [P2] (2/4) Use the allocated capacity for the locale read
**Severity:** `medium`

After querying the required size, pass the allocated buffer and capacity to the data call. Keep this with the size-query, failure handling, and P/Invoke members of the atomic fix.

```suggestion
            length = Bridge.GetLocaleInfoEx(null, localeFormat, buffer, buffer.Length);
```

confidence.rationale: The second API call must use the returned required size and allocated character array; this is the documented two-call pattern.

comments.title: Log locale format retrieval failure

selection_group.title: Size locale format buffers from GetLocaleInfoEx

comments.body:
### [P2] (3/4) Log a failed locale data read
**Severity:** `medium`

An undersized or otherwise failed nonzero-buffer read returns 0. Record that API failure before the existing early return so the field map does not silently disappear. Keep this with the atomic size-query change.

```suggestion
                Logger.LogError($"Failed to retrieve locale format {localeFormat}. Error code: {Marshal.GetLastWin32Error()}");
                return string.Empty;
```

confidence.rationale: The API returns 0 and exposes extended error information for retrieval failures; this exact diagnostic was built in the combined candidate.

comments.title: Permit null output for GetLocaleInfoEx size query

selection_group.title: Size locale format buffers from GetLocaleInfoEx

comments.body:
### [P2] (4/4) Allow the documented size-query call
**Severity:** `medium`

The size query passes a null data buffer with `cchData = 0`, as documented for `GetLocaleInfoEx`. Mark the P/Invoke array nullable so the exact-capacity lookup is represented correctly in the nullable C# signature.

```suggestion
        internal static extern int GetLocaleInfoEx(string? lpLocaleName, uint lcType, [Out] char[]? lpLCData, int cchData);
```

confidence.rationale: The API specifies the buffer is unused when cchData is zero; nullable annotation matches the two-call code and built candidate.

comments.title: Represent locale-provided seconds in picker field order

selection_group.title: Support seconds in customized short-time formats

comments.body:
### [P2] (1/5) Include seconds in the field order
**Severity:** `medium`

A customized short-time pattern may include seconds; `LOCALE_SSHORTTIME` describes their omission as typical, not guaranteed. The parsed field list drives Tab navigation, so an exposed seconds field must be represented there. Keep this insertion atomic with parsing, selected-field detection, stepping, and reading the value.

```suggestion
            Minute,
            Second,
```

confidence.rationale: Windows permits customized short-time patterns; the current upstream code drops or cannot operate on seconds when the format exposes that field.

comments.title: Parse seconds from the locale time pattern

selection_group.title: Support seconds in customized short-time formats

comments.body:
### [P2] (2/5) Parse the locale seconds token
**Severity:** `medium`

`FieldOrder` currently recognizes `h`, `H`, and `m` but not the `s` field token. When a custom short-time pattern exposes seconds, add it to the order so Tab traversal can reach the field; keep this with the remaining seconds support.

```suggestion
                    'm' => PickerField.Minute,
                    's' => PickerField.Second,
```

confidence.rationale: Windows permits customized short-time patterns; the current upstream code drops or cannot operate on seconds when the format exposes that field.

comments.title: Step the selected seconds field by one second

selection_group.title: Support seconds in customized short-time formats

comments.body:
### [P2] (3/5) Step the seconds field correctly
**Severity:** `medium`

When a locale exposes a seconds field, `StepSelectedTimeField` must map selection of that field to a one-second change. Without it, wheel input on seconds computes `TimeSpan.Zero` and makes no adjustment. Keep the mapping with the other seconds-field changes.

```suggestion
                PickerField.Minute => TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1),
                PickerField.Second => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1),
```

confidence.rationale: Windows permits customized short-time patterns; the current upstream code drops or cannot operate on seconds when the format exposes that field.

comments.title: Detect the selected seconds field

selection_group.title: Support seconds in customized short-time formats

comments.body:
### [P2] (4/5) Detect seconds when probing the selected field
**Severity:** `medium`

`SelectedField` probes the picker by incrementing a field, but currently checks only through minutes. If the selected locale field is seconds, it returns null, preventing the seconds-specific wheel step and custom field navigation. Add the seconds comparison and keep it with the other atomic members.

```suggestion
                : stepped.Minute != probe.Minute ? PickerField.Minute
                : stepped.Second != probe.Second ? PickerField.Second
```

confidence.rationale: Windows permits customized short-time patterns; the current upstream code drops or cannot operate on seconds when the format exposes that field.

comments.title: Preserve seconds only when the locale picker displays them

selection_group.title: Support seconds in customized short-time formats

comments.body:
### [P2] (5/5) Preserve displayed seconds in the expiration value
**Severity:** `medium`

`ReadPickers` always constructs the expiration time with second zero. If the locale format displays seconds, accepting the dialog silently discards the value the user selected. Preserve `time.Second` only when the field is present so formats without seconds retain the existing minute precision; keep this with the other seconds support.

```suggestion
            int second = _timeFields.Contains(PickerField.Second) ? time.Second : 0;
            return new DateTime(date.Year, date.Month, date.Day, time.Hour, time.Minute, second, DateTimeKind.Local);
```

confidence.rationale: Windows permits customized short-time patterns; the current upstream code drops or cannot operate on seconds when the format exposes that field.
